title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#353, 2026-10-06), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.9, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 18 minutes, to the first boss at 50 to 60 fps by the player's account. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on D3DMetal on a base M1, 50 to 60 fps. A DualSense was not picked up, which players report on Linux too. An XInput controller (an 8BitDo Lite) works.

knownIssues.symptom: A DualSense controller does nothing in game
knownIssues.cause: The demo's DirectInput path, which also fails on Linux (Steam community thread for the full game)
knownIssues.fix: Use an XInput controller, such as an 8BitDo in X mode (highball-db#353)
